prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: six landscape setting paintings for a children's crafted-world app character dressing room. Input image provides only the tactile hand-painted soft storybook materials, foliage and lighting style; do not recreate the phones or games.
Create one square sprite atlas with EXACTLY 6 landscape panels in a precise 2-column by 3-row grid, equal-size panels, edge-to-edge with no gutters, borders, frames, captions or text. Each panel is a complete independent 3:2 landscape scene. Canvas1536x1536; each panel768x512.
Top LEFT Sky: sunny blue sky, fluffy cream clouds, far rolling green hills, a little grassy clearing centered at bottom. No trees in center.
Top RIGHT Jungle: lush rounded tropical leaves and vines framing two sides, warm humid turquoise daylight, sandy clearing centered at bottom. No animals.
Middle LEFT Forest: woodland clearing, layered rounded trees, tiny daisies and low ferns, warm beams of sunlight, clear open central area. No animals.
Middle RIGHT Mountains: soft pale blue distant snowy mountains and foothills, grassy foreground clearing, clear sky. No characters.
Bottom LEFT Space: deep indigo-purple starry outer space, small crescent moon and one distant ringed planet, muted violet rounded moon-ground across bottom. No houses, spaceships, characters.
Bottom RIGHT Beach: calm turquoise ocean, pale sand, gentle waves, a palm and seashell at edge, clear center.
All six warm tactile painterly gouache, soft sculpted foliage, subtle canvas texture and wood-like brushed texture like the reference scene. They should feel like small handmade toy worlds, not flat vector symbols or photo-realistic renders. Keep center30% clear for an app-selected character portrait. No creatures, words, letters, UI, buttons, logos, watermarks or phones. Exactly six panels.
